subject: MerchantCo: Zip portal loads splash then 404 when using embedded iframe
messages:
From: Timothy King <tim.king@merchantco.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Trouble signing in via Zip embed — splash then 404

Hi Chloe,

We're trying to finish vendor setup for MerchantCo, but when our procurement admin clicks the 'Complete setup' button inside the Zip iframe on our portal, she sees the Zip splash screen for a second and then it redirects to a 404 (https://zip.redwood.ai/session/error). The same user can sign in fine if she uses the direct link you sent earlier, but the embedded flow fails every time. Attached a screenshot and a HAR file.

Can you advise? Our rollout deadline is Monday and this is blocking PO setup.

Thanks,
Tim
Timothy King
Head of Procurement, MerchantCo

Tim — thanks for the quick report and the files, very helpful.

Quick read: HAR shows a 302 to /session/start then a POST to /auth/iframe-handoff that returns 200 with a Set-Cookie, then a client-side redirect to /session/error (404). The cookie path looks like "/zip" in the response, but your portal runs under /vendor which might be dropping the cookie for iframe navigation.

Looping in Ben (infra) and Rafael (product ops) to confirm whether cookie path or SameSite changes from the recent iframe migration caused this.

Short-term workaround: please try the direct link (you said that works) and ask the admin to finish the PO setup there while we investigate. We can also generate a one-time magic link if needed.

I'll follow up with logs and a proposed fix by EOD.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble signing in via Zip embed — splash then 404

Thanks for the triage notes. I pulled the gateway logs for the merchantco tenant between 09:00-09:40 UTC. Observations:
- We updated the iframe routing on 2026-10-01 to add a path prefix /zip to support multi-embed flows.
- The Set-Cookie header on /auth/iframe-handoff contains Path=/zip; SameSite=None; Secure. MerchantCo's portal is mounted at /vendor on their site and the browser will not send the cookie for frames navigated under a different path.
- In Chrome, cross-site frames require Secure + SameSite=None (we have that), but path mismatch still prevents the session cookie from being sent when the iframe changes path on the parent origin.

Proposed fix (low risk): set the cookie Path=/; keep SameSite=None; Secure. This will make the cookie available to the embedded flow regardless of parent route. Rafael — can your rollout system push this change to zip's auth service as a small config change? We can hotfix and roll back if anything odd shows up.

Also added a temporary mitigation we can offer MerchantCo: provide a one-time magic link (expires 24h) that completes OAuth and does not rely on the iframe cookie.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Timothy King <tim.king@merchantco.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble signing in via Zip embed — splash then 404

Quick update: Ben's fix is implemented to the staging auth config and validated against MerchantCo's HAR. Change applied: session cookie Path=/; SameSite=None; Secure. I also added a fallback that detects the missing cookie on iframe load and redirects the frame to the magic-link flow.

Tim — can you try the same embedded flow now? If the admin still hits the 404, please clear site cookies (or try an incognito session) and retry. If that works, we'll schedule a production rollout at 22:00 UTC tonight and confirm with you post-deploy.

If you prefer, I'm happy to create the one-time magic link and paste it here for your admin to complete setup while we roll out.

Thanks for staying patient — we should have this fully resolved before your Monday window.

—Rafael
